title: Phép giảng tám ngày (Cathechismus) — Alexandre de Rhodes, Rome 1651
notes: The Vietnamese Wikisource page 'Phép giảng tám ngày' (Latin title page 'Cathechismvs ... in octo dies divisus') is a page-by-page transcription of Alexandre de Rhodes's catechism, printed in Rome in 1651 by the Congregation de Propaganda Fide; it is the first printed prose work in chữ Quốc ngữ script, and public domain. Most of the 330 pages are still marked as not yet proofread (only 3 are proofread); the text was bot-imported in 2018 and partly edited in 2022, and is usable transcribed text rather than raw OCR. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Vietnamese Wikisource community (proofread transcription of the Congregatio de Propaganda Fide editio princeps)
